16.11.2023 Heard Mr R A Ahmed, learned counsel for the petitioner, Suchitra Mandal.

2. The petitioner has filed this application under Section 439 CrPC, with prayer for bail, as she is in jail since 04.10.2023, in connection with Mayong PS Case No. 118/2023, under Section 376(1) IPC,
read with Sections 6/17 of the POCSO Act, read Page No.# 2/2 with Sections 9/10/11 of the Child Marriage Prohibition Act, 2006.

3. Heard Mr B Sarma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.

sentences.text:
Office Note dated 08.11.2023 indicates that notices were issued to the respondent No. 2.
5. Case Diary is received.
6.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
7. I have also perused the Case Diary.
8. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the victim eloped with the petitioner and he is not liable under the POCSO Act or under Section 376 IPC.
It is submitted that the statement of the victim under Section 164 CrPC reveals that the victim eloped with the petitioner on her own volition.
The petitioner is behind the bars for 44 days.
9. Further custodial detention of the petitioner for the sake of investigation may not be required.
Investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
The petitioner is a local resident and he is not a flight risk.
The petitioner is the husband of the victim.
10. In view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs.
50,000/-, with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO), Morigaon.
11.
Bail Application stands disposed of.
12. Send back the Case Diary.
